(a) Complete the table.

$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{Delay (minutes)} & \text{Number of motorists}\\ \hline 4-6 & 6\\ \hline 7-8 & \\ \hline 9 & 21\\ \hline 10-12 & 45\\ \hline 13-15 & 9\\ \hline 16-20 & \\ \hline\end{array}$
(2)
(b) Estimate the number of motorists who were delayed between 8.5 and 13.5 minutes by the roadworks.
(2)

A1 for $\frac{5}{12}$ or follow through from their method. Accept exact equivalent.
Correct answer only with no working M1A1 but must be clearly labelled (c).

parts.mark_scheme:
M1 for using $1-$'their $\mathrm{P}(B)$' or $(\mathrm{P}(A \cup B) - \mathrm{P}(A))/\mathrm{P}(A)$ or $(\mathrm{P}(A) - \mathrm{P}(A \cap B))/\mathrm{P}(A)$ with a correct attempt at the numerator and denominator. If mutually exclusive is assumed then the last option gives $\frac{1/4}{1/4}$ for M1.

questions.stem:
The marks, $x$, of 45 students randomly selected from those students who sat a mathematics examination are shown in the stem and leaf diagram below.

$\begin{array}{|c|l|c|}\hline \text{Mark} & & \text{Totals}\\ \hline 3 & 6\ 9\ 9 & (3)\\ \hline 4 & 0\ 1\ 2\ 2\ 3\ 4 & (6)\\ \hline 4 & 5\ 6\ 6\ 6\ 8 & (5)\\ \hline 5 & 0\ 2\ 3\ 3\ 4\ 4 & (6)\\ \hline 5 & 5\ 5\ 6\ 7\ 7\ 9 & (6)\\ \hline 6 & 0\ 0\ 0\ 0\ 1\ 3\ 4\ 4\ 4 & (9)\\ \hline 6 & 5\ 5\ 6\ 7\ 8\ 9 & (6)\\ \hline 7 & 1\ 2\ 3\ 3 & (4)\\ \hline\end{array}$

Key (3|6 means 36)

parts.label: a
parts.text:
(a) Write down the modal mark of these students.
(1)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
(b) Find the values of the lower quartile, the median and the upper quartile.
(3)
parts.mark_scheme:
B1 for $Q_1 = 46$
B1 for $Q_2 = 56$
B1 for $Q_3 = 64$
Award each B1 for correct answer only in this order.

parts.label: c
parts.text:
For these students $\sum x = 2497$ and $\sum x^2 = 143\,369$

(c) Find the mean and the standard deviation of the marks of these students.
(3)
parts.mark_scheme:
B1 for mean = 55.48… or $\frac{2497}{45}$, awrt 55.5
M1 for use of correct formula, including square root.
A1 for sd $= \sqrt{\frac{143369}{45}-\left(\frac{2497}{45}\right)^2} = 10.342…$ (s = 10.459…) anything which rounds to 10.3 (or s = 10.5)
Correct answers with no working B1M1A1.

parts.label: d
parts.text:
(d) Describe the skewness of the marks of these students, giving a reason for your answer.
(2)
parts.mark_scheme:
B1 any correct comparison of a pair of mean, median and mode using their values, e.g. Mean < median < mode or $Q_2-Q_1>Q_3-Q_2$ with or without their numbers or median closer to upper quartile (than lower quartile) or (mean-median)/sd <0
B1dep for 'negative skew' or allow (almost) symmetrical dependent upon correct reason.

parts.label: e
parts.text:
The mean and standard deviation of the marks of all the students who sat the examination were 55 and 10 respectively. The examiners decided that the total mark of each student should be scaled by subtracting 5 marks and then reducing the mark by a further 10 %.

(e) Find the mean and standard deviation of the scaled marks of all the students.
(4)
parts.mark_scheme:
M1 for $(55\text{ or }55.5-5)\times0.9$
A1 for the correct answer only, mean = 45.
M1 for $(10\text{ or }10.3\text{ or }10.5)\times0.9$
A1 for the correct answer only, sd = 9.

parts.text:
(b) Find the value of $w$ such that $\mathrm{P}(232<W<w) = 0.20$
